messages:
maya: ok this is wild — found a damp pair of socks wrapped in plastic sitting next to the leftover sashimi in the office fridge. i have secured the artifact. :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
sam: WHAT. pls post evidence or it didn't happen :eyes:
maya: https://imgur.com/a/office-sock - blurred for fashion. note the soy sauce stain pattern, could be tribal. :sushi:
devon: we need a name. options: 'Sashimi Socks', 'Soy-Soaked Sentiment', 'Milo's Mourning Sock' (if milo admits), or 'The Fridge Relic'. vote with emoji. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
jen: if there's going to be a shrine i'm building it. also pro tip: tag it in lost-and-found board so ops can decide if it's biohazard. :raised_hands:
milo: i swear those are not mine. i was wearing socks that day but mine are plain, not artistically marinated. :confused:
maya: @milo i asked the socks and they whisper your name. (this is how evidence works now) :laughing:
sam: i vote :sushi: for Sashimi Socks. devon you pick the ceremony date.
devon: Saturday 3pm: ceremonial placement on top of the microwave, incense optional. who brings the tiny flag?
jen: i'll make a tiny flag. will accept contributions in stickers/wasabi. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
kitchen-bot: Found item logged: '1x textile (socks) - refrigerated - tagged as potential biohazard' — custodial notified. Cleanup scheduled Mon 09:00.
milo: okay but if they throw my socks away i'm starting a lobby. :point_up_2: also can we put a label 'DO NOT EAT' next to it?
maya: label printed. winding up Sashimi Socks nomination. last call for objections. :gavel:
sam: no objections. long live Sashimi Socks. :crown: 
devon: photo of shrine incoming. pls do not bring actual sushi to ceremony.
jen: note to future employees: always check sushi containers before putting socks in fridge.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: fridge audits happen monthly. if you want an item returned, file claim by Tue 17:00.
